en: The more I see, the more familiar the Avali feel.
Reminds me of a market on Avos.
These have much value in decor!
It's a bit too small to place anything of worth inside, but it's still pretty.
ko: 가치 있는 걸 넣기엔 좀 작지만, 그래도 예뻐.

en: I wonder if they have an Avian fairy tales?
Avians often store trinkets in pots. Perhaps Mantizi do the same.
ko: 에이비언은 장신구를 항아리에 넣곤 해. 만티지도 같은 모양이야.

en: I've seen a lot of plants like this already. The Skath seem to like to decorate their interiors with these.
ko: 이런 식물은 이미 많이 봤어. 스카스는 이걸로 실내를 장식하나 봐.

en: This display is mounted firmly on the wall.
ko: 이 디스플레이는 벽에 단단히 고정돼 있어.

en: A hollow ice sphere. Like a crystal ball.
ko: 속이 빈 얼음 구체. 수정 구슬 같아.

en: Must... look... away... from the light.
I really have no idea if this is supposed to be a bow or a gun.
These crystals remind me of the ones in our temples.
ko: 이 수정들은 우리 신전에 있는 것들이 생각나.

en: This pot's dull opaque glaze does little to whet my appetite.
ko: 이 항아리의 칙칙한 무광 유약은 식욕을 안 돋워.

en: This looks like it could stop water from getting through.
ko: 이건 물이 통과하는 걸 막을 수 있을 것 같아.

en: The light it gives off is so cold...
I can use this station to talk to S.A.I.L..
ko: 이 스테이션으로 S.A.I.L과 대화할 수 있어.

en: The grounded make similar banners.
A chance to utilise one's survival skills.
A floop sign.
I wish my damned wings worked. But nooo...
ko: 망할 날개가 작동했으면 좋겠는데. 하지만 안 돼지...

en: I can see what's inside through the slime. That's neat!
Either it's a desk for kneeling, or a feast table for very small people.
ko: 무릎 꿇고 쓰는 책상이거나 아주 작은 사람들의 연회 탁자야.

en: It's a shoat egg. They can be very disgusting.
ko: 숏의 알이야. 아주 징그러울 수 있어.

en: Never have I ever in my life ever heard such an awful cacophony.
Ideal for serving out an oculemonade on a hot day.
The surface of the table is glassy smooth, but plates seem to adhere until moved.
ko: 탁자 표면은 유리처럼 매끄럽지만 접시가 붙어 있다가 움직여.

en: Bless my beak, such a comfortable captain's chair.
ko: 부리에게 축복을, 정말 편안한 선장 의자야.

en: With a guard, Kluex wouldn't dare touch me.
ko: 경비병이 있으면 클루엑스도 날 못 건드릴 거야.

en: I'm not sure I like the smell of this plant...
ko: 이 식물 냄새가 별로 마음에 안 들어...

en: A tough plant, somewhat similar to wheat. The seeds don't taste as good, though.
ko: 밀과 좀 비슷한 강인한 식물이야. 다만 씨앗 맛은 별로야.

en: A big metal box - it's somehow cold to the touch.
ko: 큰 금속 상자야 - 어쩐지 만지면 차가워.

en: I wonder how I should open this chest...?
An electric statue of a planet?
Weathered wood that's been crafted into planks.
A suspended nest, what an interesting idea!
Reminds me of a market on Avos
A screen without a screen, that's interesting...
I really have no idea what this is meant to be.
This reminds me of the computers the stargazers use.
Looks like a crystal lamp. Does it use Avian technology too?
ko: 수정 램프 같아. 에이비언 기술도 쓰는 걸까?

en: The rind is unbearably salty, but the pulpy flesh inside tastes a bit like lightly salted corn.
ko: 껍질은 참을 수 없이 짜지만, 안의 과육은 살짝 간한 옥수수 맛이야.

en: Too hard for my beak to puncture. Not worth it.
ko: 내 부리로 뚫기엔 너무 단단해. 그럴 가치가 없어.

en: Is it real? Very strange combination...
This fruit looks like it's obsessed.
ko: 이 과일은 뭔가에 집착하는 것 같아.

en: This little glowing bush produces solarium! How wonderful!
ko: 이 작은 빛나는 관목은 솔라리움을 생산해! 얼마나 멋져!

en: This tastes like something a human would eat around one of their holidays.
Violiroot is a great source of metal.
A comfortable wooden seat.
A table of high quality.
A bowl suitable for Kluex Himself.
Such an ornate vase!
The faceted crystal in the centre is so lovely.
ko: 중앙의 면을 잡은 수정이 정말 사랑스러워.

en: Such a lovely crystalline glow.
Such a beautiful lantern. Though it looks rather familiar...
ko: 아름다운 랜턴이야. 근데 어딘가 익숙하게 생겼어...

en: These look oddly similar to our crystal technology...
ko: 이건 우리 수정 기술과 묘하게 비슷해...

en: Building this may have been a bad idea.
I can use this station to enable tech and talk to S.A.I.L.
ko: 이 스테이션으로 테크를 켜고 S.A.I.L과 대화할 수 있어.

en: How convenient, I can reach the fuel hatch from the chair.
This looks like a teleporter, but it's so small...
The surface of this table is quite streamlined.
A sleek console built by the Skath. I wonder what it does?
ko: 스카스가 만든 날렵한 콘솔이야. 뭘 하는 걸까?

en: The flickering of the screen makes me feel dizzy. I can't read what it says.
ko: 화면의 깜빡임이 어지럽게 해. 글자를 못 읽겠어.

en: This weapon seems to fire starmatter at a rapid speed.
ko: 이 무기는 스타매터를 빠른 속도로 쏘는 것 같아.

en: Will I get slime in my feathers?
Does anyone like sticky lamps?
I can use this to create extra equipment and armour not available at a replicator.
ko: 이걸로 리플리케이터에 없는 추가 장비와 갑옷을 만들 수 있어.

en: A plain looking bed. The sheets are fresh.
A fountain.
What could I possibly want with humans?
Is this the aether? The eternal sky.
Perhaps these Glitch could serve as workers.
ko: 이 글리치들은 일꾼으로 쓸 수 있겠어.

en: Magic and science. What a beautiful union.
This is a really big flower.
This woman is turning to look at something, perhaps.
ko: 이 여자는 뭔가를 보려고 돌아보는 것 같아.

en: A statue of a monster. The inscription says it's called Derrick.
ko: 괴물의 동상이야. 명문에 데릭이라고 적혀 있어.

en: An old table. It's in pretty poor condition.
These old turbines are barely standing.
ko: 이 낡은 터빈들은 겨우 서 있어.

en: How unelegant this machine is.
A console. It doesn't work.
Summoning a chef would be perfect.
If only I could fly before the sun.
I'll have to take care not to use this too often.
ko: 이걸 너무 자주 안 쓰게 조심해야겠어.

en: The chair is caked in filth.
This would be improved if it had Kluex in it.
Did I set this alarm off?
Damaged wiring.
A smooth, cold, inviting chest.
What an unappealing table.
What is this creature?
Why is this Apex on a clam shell. What is this?
ko: 왜 이 에이펙스가 조개껍데기 위에 있지? 이게 뭐야?

en: I'm not sure I want to spawn Florans.
It's a turbine... Or it was.
This is ominous.
Perhaps I can use this to summon fellow Grounded.
ko: 이걸로 동료 지상파를 소환할 수 있을지도.

en: This is a really big mushroom.
A solemn human. He wears a plumage.
ko: 엄숙한 인간이야. 깃털 장식을 쓰고 있어.

en: Just static.
This hanging ceiling light is crafted from copper.
I'm confused - Why is the woman standing on a clam shell?
ko: 혼란스러워 - 왜 저 여자가 조개껍데기 위에 서 있지?

en: An Apex dispenser. Unusual.
A research table.
This is how it feels not to know about Kluex.
Such technology is controversial on Avos.
It is clear to see that Angels appreciate their religious symbols very much. This glass is covered with them.
ko: 엔젤들이 종교 문양을 정말 좋아한다는 게 보여. 이 유리는 그것들로 뒤덮였어.

en: An uncomfortable ancient bench.
An ancient chair. It doesn't look very comfortable.
ko: 고대 의자야. 그리 편해 보이진 않아.

en: Is this an ancient pedestal or a tall sacrificial pillar?
ko: 이건 고대 받침대야, 아니면 높은 제물 기둥이야?

en: This is an ancient table.
An Angel's bookcase. They store their knowledge here.
These appear to be connected pillars with some Angel-themed colors.
ko: 엔젤 테마 색의 연결된 기둥들 같아.

en: An Angelic campfire. It's useful for very basic cooking.
ko: 엔젤 모닥불이야. 아주 기본적인 요리에 유용해.

en: This chest looks sacred, the contents should be valuable!
ko: 이 상자는 신성해 보여, 내용물이 귀중할 거야!

en: What is this mysterious thing? Two tiny separated rooms, yet facing each other..with a screen you can barely see through...
ko: 이 신비한 건 뭐지? 작은 분리된 방 둘이 마주보고 있어.. 겨우 보이는 화면과 함께.

en: So Angels also decorate their homes with tapestry...? It's so..colorful..for them.
ko: 엔젤도 집을 태피스트리로 꾸미나...? 저들치고 참.. 알록달록하네..

en: Angel clothes seem to be in this special box.
ko: 엔젤 옷이 이 특별한 상자에 있는 것 같아.

en: An end table designed by an Angel. It has a Angel-themed design.
ko: 엔젤이 디자인한 협탁이야. 엔젤 테마 디자인이야.

en: What a delightful array of blooms. They look like they are pouring out!
ko: 어여쁜 꽃들의 향연이네. 쏟아져 나오는 것 같아!

en: The movement of this flower in the breeze looks like..flowing water.
ko: 산들바람에 흔들리는 이 꽃의 움직임은 마치.. 흐르는 물 같아.

en: The shape and color of this flower reminds me of the Sun..
ko: 이 꽃의 모양과 색은 태양을 생각나게 해..

en: One would think they are entering a righteous garden with a gate like this at the entrance.
ko: 입구에 이런 문이 있으면 정의로운 정원에 들어서는 줄 알겠어.
